narr: Scattered thunderstorms moved slowly west across southeast Arizona during the afternoon and evening. Storms produced pockets of heavy rain with flash flooding observed in parts of the Tucson Metro area.
ev: Heavy rain of 1-1.5 in less than 1 hour in the Broadway/Alvernon area led to rises in Arroyo Chico Wash. Crossings at Plumer Ave. and others were impassable. Additionally, a man on foot was swept away near 6th St. and 9th Ave. He was rescued, but sustained minor injuries.

Heavy rain of 1-2 in 1 hour caused flash flooding of roadways in southeast Tucson. Road closures included Wilmot Rd. north of Noyes, Escalante Rd. at Atterbury Wash and Harrison Rd. at the Pantano Wash.
